game_concept: A adventure race set in The Kingdom – Archery Yard, the garrison archery yard: the knight must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Inventory Slots: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against shadow scouts.
theme: The Kingdom – Archery Yard: the garrison archery yard
core_gameplay_loop: In Archery Yard, repeat each round: Store each item in its own variable and choose which one to spend against shadow scouts. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the knight ahead. Then check the potion value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the wall banner by solving code steps involving potion that move the knight forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the wall banner first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Inventory Slots
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Inventory Slots' (Week 1 slot 8), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Archery Yard'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how potion changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Archery Yard.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.85).
